name: fix-windows-portable-startup-window-visibility
title: Fix Windows portable startup window visibility
description: Restore discoverable packaged-Windows startup while keeping the portable main window and settings UI visually aligned with the development build.
creator: Mabel-WIN
notes: As of 2026-03-28, the long-running blank-window regression has a confirmed packaged-renderer root cause: Vite production output was still emitting root-relative /assets/... URLs while Electron packaged BrowserWindows load dist/index.html over file://. That caused main and settings to show only their native host backgrounds with no React JS/CSS loaded, which was repeatedly misread as a transparent-window/compositor failure. The build base has now been corrected to emit ./assets/... for packaged output. Remaining work is narrowed back to true packaged-Windows shell parity and styling, not renderer non-loading.
